title: Compare cleanup storage for small and empty workspaces
steps: Inspect small workspace with one 13,858-byte JPEG and empty workspace with no photos.
Open Account cleanup from Tenant Subscription Management.
Set Max photos to 1 and Max storage (MB) to 1, wait for both candidate rows, and compare their Content values.

video_guide.summary: Compare the Content column: the empty workspace shows 0 B, while the small photo uses 14 KB.

chapters.note: Account cleanup lists the empty workspace with 0 photos and 0 B.

chapters.label: Set cleanup limits and compare Content

chapters.note: The adjusted limits reveal small workspace with 1 photo and 14 KB.
Both rows remain visible with distinct, readable storage values.
